answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding every identity to bonded collateral and auditable message histories: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), rather than independently. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents cheap recovery. A jetty, garden, or terrace of aliases therefore cannot dilute accountability.
